title: Data Compression Toolkit — zlib
description: Widely used compression library for DEFLATE streams.
body:
1. Tool identity. This record is the public-edition reference for zlib, a data compression toolkit. Widely used compression library for DEFLATE streams. Category: Data Processing and File Engineering.

2. Actual implementation. A working implementation ships inside this record as executable JavaScript (demo.program) and was executed in Node.js; the verified output is stored in demo.output. The demonstration exercises the tool's core behavior: [zlib] RLE compressed 30 chars -> 3 runs (ratio 10.0:1).

3. Inputs and outputs. This class of tool takes files and binary blobs and produces converted data and inspection reports. The demonstration's input is a scenario selector (0-7); its output is the human-readable result line kept in demo.output.

4. Execution instructions. Requires Node.js 18 or later and nothing else. Save demo.program to a file, append a call such as console.log(demoMain(0, 'demo')), and run it with node. No dependencies are installed and no network is used.

5. Tests and examples. This record's demonstration scenario was executed in Node.js and its real output captured in demo.output. Re-running demoMain with the same scenario index reproduces it byte-for-byte.
